goals: Beperkt middel en haalbare mogelijkheden aanwijzen
Totale uitkomsten voor hetzelfde tijdvak of dezelfde ruimte vergelijken
Een keuze bij een expliciet doel beoordelen
pageVerification: Complete student PDF pages 6–11 visually inspected, including printed footers; physical index equals printed page for these pages. Teacher source uses chapter-local pages, converted by +4 and verified.

startSupport.exercise1: Retrieval of multiplication, subtraction and units; no earlier economics paragraph. Revisit if arithmetic is fragile.
startSupport.exercise2: New scarcity and foregone alternative, supported exploration using theory printed p. 6–8. Overview support line visible on all three copies. Return to exercise 2 after explanation, before basis work.

Definition, atelier scenario and excluded unavailable option; book p. 6–8.

prerequisiteTrace.operation: Best remaining feasible option; not sum, difference or payment
prerequisiteTrace.instruction: Atelier worked example, comparison table, Lina multiple-alternative example; book p. 7–8.

authoredTeachingExamples.name: Atelier op zaterdag
authoredTeachingExamples.label: Uitlegvoorbeeld — niet uit het boek
authoredTeachingExamples.data: One room for two hours, both workshops use all two hours; free room, amounts after expenditure. Papieratelier € 25 per hour / 24 participants; textielatelier € 40 per hour / 16 participants. Houtatelier unavailable because trainer absent.
authoredTeachingExamples.outcome: € 50 versus € 80, choose textile for money, foregone paper € 50; difference € 30; choose paper for participation.

authoredTeachingExamples.name: Lina heeft twee uur
authoredTeachingExamples.label: Uitlegvoorbeeld — niet uit het boek
authoredTeachingExamples.data: Chosen walk; two feasible mutually exclusive whole-two-hour jobs give € 22 and € 18; € 30 theatre job unavailable.
authoredTeachingExamples.outcome: € 22 best forgone income, not € 40 sum. No monetary value invented for walking.

targetCoverage.a: Scarce aula during the same three hours; individually feasible, incompatible.
targetCoverage.e: Choose music for 90 versus 60 expected participants.
